name: Public Records — Etsy search listings to HTTP
author: Public Records
description: Run publicrecords/etsy-search-scraper on YOUR Apify account via HTTP, then use the JSON rows in later modules (Google Sheets, Slack, email). Set APIFY_TOKEN in a Make connection or variable. Do not hard-code a token. Official Make gallery submission needs a Make account and is not included.

metadata.notes: Rebuild in Make with the HTTP module if import of this blueprint is rejected; the URL, method, header and body are the recipe.
